name: Datacenter del Estado Dominicano
developer: Oficina Presidencial de Tecnologias de la Informacion y Comunicacion (OPTIC/OGTIC)
notes: Official OGTIC/Presidency article says OPTIC put the state datacenter into operation as a large data center supporting automation of public institutions. Exact facility address/capacity not disclosed in source; assigned to Distrito Nacional due Santo Domingo government/OGTIC context.

name: Google Puerto Internacional de Intercambio Digital en RD
notes: Official Presidency source says Google will establish its first Latin America digital exchange port in Dominican territory, a world-class facility for AI-related data flow/processing, plus submarine cables. Exact build site and capacity not disclosed; source is Santo Domingo/Palacio Nacional announcement, so division assignment is uncertain.
